create.name: Sianna Sherman
create.bio:
Sianna Sherman is a yoga teacher and storyteller who has led classes, festivals and teacher trainings in dozens of countries over almost thirty years. She founded Rasa Yoga, a school whose trainings blend asana, mantra, mudra, breath, functional anatomy and Tantric philosophy, and she created Mythic Yoga Flow, in which each class is built around a tale of a deity, sage or hero from the yoga tradition, such as Hanuman, Ganesha or Lakshmi. Before yoga took over her working life she practised bodywork and gathered wild plants for herbal remedies.

Alongside yoga she studies Celtic lore and the eight festivals of the Wheel of the Year, which feed into RITUAL, her moon-based school of ceremony and earth-centred practice. She also works with hypnosis and shadow work, and her online community ALCHEMY meets each week for live yoga and mindset meditation. Many of her retreats are shared with her partner, the handpan and kirtan musician Masood Ali Khan, with whom she runs Fearless Heart Activations, a series of open conversations, and Alchemy of Love, on intimacy and self-love. Her recorded courses cover the chakras, mantra and Sanskrit, anatomy and Tantric texts, and she leads retreats at Esalen, the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas and in Peru.

courses.title: Mythic Yoga Flow®: A Full Moon Retreat with the Stories and Practices of Yoga
courses.description: A five-day Esalen retreat at full moon, co-led with musician Masood Ali Khan. Each day follows a figure from yoga's stories, from Shiva and Shakti to Hanuman, Ganesha, Vishnu and Durga, through postures, breathing, mantra, mudra, meditation and guided hypnosis.

courses.title: Mythic Yoga Flow® Online Master Course
courses.description: A home-study course of 14 modules in which every vinyasa class is built around a story from the yoga tradition, with mantra, mudra, breath and meditation. It comes with live music journeys and is open to practitioners and teachers.

courses.title: ALCHEMY Membership
courses.description: Her online community with live yoga and meditation each week, including a Monday mindset meditation and a Wednesday Rasa Yoga class. Monthly or yearly, with a free trial.
courses.price: $25 USD per month or $247 USD per year

courses.title: Alchemy of Machu Picchu Yoga Retreat 2027: A Sacred Return
courses.description: An eight-day journey through Peru's Sacred Valley with Masood Ali Khan, ending at Machu Picchu on 8 August. Days mix yoga, breathwork, sound and Andean ceremony, and the trip is run by True Nature Travels.

courses.title: Mythic Yoga Flow: Myth, Mantra, Mudra & Music at Sivananda Ashram Bahamas
courses.description: A four-day programme at the Sivananda ashram on Paradise Island with Masood Ali Khan, pairing yoga practice with stories of yoga's saints, heroes and deities and live music.

free_resources.title: Free Lakshmi Asana Flow
free_resources.description: A recorded 20-minute yoga class for all levels themed on the goddess Lakshmi. It is sent by email after signing up and can be repeated as often as you like.
